scope: Proposition 14.11 (Quasiconvexity from bounded segment stabilizers) of the manuscript “Virtual compact specialness of hyperbolic one-relator groups” (preprints/Virtual-compact-specialness-of-hyperbolic-one-relator-groups-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 258 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a6c45541e6943005), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 103. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let A be a hyperbolic group expressed as a finite graph of finitely generated hyperbolic groups. Suppose the edge maps are quasi-isometric embeddings and there is an integer n such that every length-n Bass–Serre segment has finite pointwise stabilizer. Then every vertex and edge group is quasiconvex in A. In particular this applies to the filled graph of groups of Theorem 14.9.
